metadata.description: Agent Skills for presentations, images, audio and video.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Raw PowerPoint (.pptx) operations: inspect, fill, add shapes with measured text, check overflow, copy slides between decks; offline reveal.js slideshows.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Image, music and voiceover generation with the models of the model config (API providers, Ollama or local diffusers models), short narrated videos, image-to-image video effects, infographics and slide deck authoring.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Implementation plans, and Agent Skill authoring and review.

plugins.name: brand
plugins.description: Brand folders (logos, colours, fonts, guidelines, PowerPoint templates) found in the bundled brands and in BRAND_PATH.

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: Classification and scoring of text with System-1 models or chat models, and review of files by a second model, on the providers of the model config (Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI or a company gateway).

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A local web page in the browser for making images, infographics, slide decks and short videos with Claude: projects, styles, versions and marked changes, carried out by this Claude Code session.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Installation of the pcingola-skills marketplace and its plugins, and the settings file config.yaml: models, keys and every setting a skill reads.
